name: rg-flag-guard
description: PreToolUse guard against ripgrep's silent flag traps: rg -r is --replace (not recursive) and -h is --help (not --no-filename), both failing silently with exit 0. Denies the trap shapes with the mechanically corrected command pasted into the reason, sees through wrappers (timeout, xargs, sudo, env, rtk, snip), and allows every deliberate --replace idiom the real-world corpus contains.
